title: Khaled / Product portfolio
description: Khaled is a founder in Dubai building practical products for quotation, customer support and property teams.
about: I’m Khaled, a founder based in Dubai. I build practical products around the work between a conversation and a decision: preparing a quotation, helping a customer, qualifying an enquiry and getting a tenancy ready. This is a living collection of that work.

projects.name: Quote Operations
projects.modelDescription: Quotation software for HVAC contractors and equipment teams.
projects.audience: HVAC contractors, estimators and commercial reviewers
projects.buyer: Commercial directors and quotation desk managers
projects.users: Estimators, sales engineers and commercial reviewers
headline: Clear scope.
Reviewed quotes.
projects.summary: A quotation workspace that keeps the equipment request, price source, approval and revision together.
projects.problem: Equipment requirements, pricing questions and commercial approvals arrive in different places. Estimators need a complete request and a clear view of what still needs attention before a quotation goes out.
features: Prepare equipment quantities, capacities and requirements in one request.
Build a sourced quotation and keep missing requirements visible.
Require a separate approver for each quotation version.
Create a revision without overwriting the approved version. Download HTML and CSV.
nextFocus: Validate the workflow with an equipment team
Confirm commercial pricing rules for a pilot
Turn operational feedback into focused improvements
projects.imageAlt: Guided sample of the HVAC quotation workflow
projects.demoNote: Try the public sample workspace without signing in. The product website includes a narrated 40-second animated walkthrough using fictional requests and prices.

updates.text: Made the sample quotation directly accessible from the website and portfolio. Explore without an email, booking or account.
Published the public sample workspace and a narrated 40-second walkthrough, covering request preparation, independent approval and revisions.
Updated the current demo, quotation export and full brand kit. The product now uses a shared green, paper and lime palette.
Added an estimator workspace with RFQ preparation, quotation review and revision comparison.

projects.name: Oris
projects.modelDescription: A customer experience platform for business teams.
projects.audience: E-commerce brands and customer support teams
projects.users: Support agents and the customers they help
headline: Every conversation,
with context.
projects.summary: Arabic and English customer support built around business knowledge, useful answers and a clear handoff to a person.
projects.problem: Customers switch languages and channels. Support teams need the business context and conversation history in one place so the next person can help without starting again.
features: Connect business knowledge to Arabic and English customer conversations.
Support WhatsApp and web chat, with voice in beta.
Find conversations that need attention, search loaded records and open the original conversation.
Prepare an internal handoff draft with the recorded context.
projects.demoNote: Visit the public product website for the current product offering.

updates.text: Added a bilingual product experience and a focused conversation handoff desk.

projects.name: Manzl
projects.modelDescription: Leasing assistance for brokerages and property managers.
projects.audience: UAE brokerages and property management teams
projects.buyer: Heads of property management and leasing directors
projects.users: Leasing coordinators, agents and prospective tenants
headline: Meet Reem.
Move things forward.
projects.summary: An AI leasing assistant that qualifies enquiries, proposes viewing slots and prepares a useful handoff for the human agent.
projects.problem: Leasing enquiries arrive while agents are busy with viewings. Budget, area, move date and requirements get scattered across conversations, leaving the next agent to reconstruct the brief.
features: Guide Arabic and English enquiries through the leasing qualification flow.
Bring budget, location, move date, bedrooms and cheque preferences together.
Keep missing details and the recorded next action visible beside the conversation.
Prepare a concise internal handoff and continue into the original lead record.
projects.imageAlt: Illustrative apartment with warm natural materials
projects.demoNote: Working prototype. A public interactive demo is not available yet.

updates.text: Added a leasing qualification workspace with missing details and copyable handoff briefs.

projects.name: Aqd
projects.modelDescription: Team software for the week between a tenant saying yes and registration.
projects.buyer: Heads of leasing and brokerage operations
projects.users: Leasing teams working with landlords and tenants
headline: A clearer start.
A calmer handoff.
projects.summary: A tenancy close pack that brings property details, documents, cheque planning and open items into one preparation flow.
projects.problem: After a tenant says yes, leasing teams still need to assemble documents, confirm details and agree the payment schedule. Those open items often remain scattered across WhatsApp threads.
features: Prepare a tenancy pack through a guided workflow.
See readiness gaps, add suggested owners and prepare a clear handoff brief.
Plan an annual rent schedule with cheque counts and month-end dates.
Preview the pack through a PDF and print workflow.
nextFocus: Feedback from a leasing team pilot
projects.demoNote: Working preparation demo; not publicly available yet. It does not verify identity or connect to government registration services.

updates.text: Added a readiness desk, suggested owners and a rent schedule planner.

intro:

I build practical products for busy teams.
